title: Automatically provision project schedules during setup and approved startup
description: Owner expects TORCH scheduling to be part of the product, not a separate manual cron chore. The current install defines a 15-minute manager check-in but does not install a host timer. Integrate idempotent scheduler planning/provisioning into guided setup and explicit fleet activation. Respect the existing stopped-until-ready boundary: setup/dry-run cannot wake models; only approved fleet startup enables recurring coordination within reviewed budgets. Direct-report schedules adapt to graph changes; unsupported hosts must show an actionable supported fallback or explicit limitation. Preserve unrelated host timers; stop/uninstall disable/remove only TORCH-owned integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner-reviewed setup configures project schedules and approved startup activates the correct owned scheduler without a second manual command
No live wake occurs during dry-run; stopped setup; restore-only reinstall; or without reviewed activation policy
Restart/reinstall/graph changes reconcile idempotently without duplicate units or orphan wakes
Manager checks cover approval waits and stale work; deploys/notifications retain separate authority; uninstall verifies owned scheduler removal
